review_process.note: Criterion 1 was filled deterministically before reveal. Criteria 2-4 and preferences were completed blind. A post-reveal correction changed reviewer metadata only; original scoring artifacts remain preserved.

evidence_projection.scope: freeze/source/prepared/run/review/provenance hashes; reviewer correction; all outputs, expected artifacts, item criteria, preferences, aggregate analysis, candidate gate, and decision

candidate_gate.definition: Open a local 0.1.1 design only when both cases in one mechanism have ours artifact criterion failures >=2/3 and baseline failures <=1/3 for each case; upstream and criteria 2-4 do not trigger it.

forward_result.observation: All three arms produced 18/18 exact Markdown artifacts. Baseline and ours passed 72/72 criteria; upstream passed 71/72 because one message did not distinguish a planned note target. All 18 items had no unique preference: 17 were three-way equal, and one had baseline and ours tied for best.
forward_result.interpretation: The six narrow prompts were sufficient for exact artifact production without a Skill, so this run shows preservation capability but no measured accuracy or preference benefit from the local Skill. The local and upstream Skill arms used more tokens, cost, and latency than baseline in this run.

decision.reason: All 54 submitted notes passed the deterministic artifact criterion, so no case qualified for the frozen local candidate gate. Baseline and ours were both perfect on all 72 criteria; adding instructions is not supported by this sample.

limitations: Only six synthetic narrow-edit tasks, one model, one reasoning effort, and three repetitions per arm were tested.
The blind reviewer and post-score reviewer were model-assisted subagents, not independent humans.
The run compared returned text artifacts in read-only sessions; it did not edit a real vault or verify Obsidian rendering, link scans, plugins, or filesystem preservation.
Explicit project-level Skill invocation was configured, but the run has no per-session Skill-call trace, so this is not an implicit-routing evaluation.
Cost and latency differences describe this run and should not be generalized to all prompts or models.

The 13 raw run artifacts are intentionally ignored by Git. Their hashes can be rechecked when the local run directory is present; a fresh clone can only recompute the embedded outputs against committed frozen sources, packages, reviews, and the pinned evidence projection.
